title: Exactly Verifiable Infeasibility Certificates for Robot Motion Planning — code, certificates and benchmark data
description: Code, certificates and benchmark data accompanying the paper Exactly Verifiable Infeasibility Certificates for Robot Motion Planning. An independent 499-line verifier, using only the Python standard library, re-checks infeasibility certificates for articulated-arm motion planning in exact rational arithmetic. The release contains the verifier, the generator (rational forward kinematics, Bernstein-LP witnesses, branch-and-bound), the scene files, the certificate of every certified scene up to a 7-DOF KUKA iiwa7, the dated benchmark files the paper reads its numbers from, and the full development record (in French).
